QuestInfo.name: The King of Thieves
QuestInfo.0: Go to the Dark Lord in Kerning City.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Dark Lord in Kerning City.
QuestInfo.2: You collected the third Augury from the Dark Lord. Return to Vieren.

0.0: Who are you? You don't look like the thieving type.\r\n#L0##bYour informant sent me. Somebody that used to be a part of my organization left something here and I'm here to retrieve it.#l\n#k
0.1: So you are the person of the revelation. I'll return the Augury.

yes.0: One thing you should know. This was left to a Dark Lord generations before me. I received it along with the revelation that someone would one day come for it.

1.0: So you want to see the family heirloom? Why?\r\n#L0##bMy old master entrusted your family with the heirloom long ago.#l\n#k
1.1: I see. We've held onto this for generations, waiting for the day a stranger would come looking for it. Tell me, who are you with?\r\n#L0##bAurora. Is that the name you wanted to hear?#l\n#k
1.2: All right. The heirloom is yours.
